C0135.title: Beware: Discounted Utility Bill Payments Used as Money Laundering Front, Leading to One-Year Prison Sentence
C0135.summary: Xiamen Anti-Fraud Center reveals a case where Liu found a store on Xianyu offering 20% off electricity bill payments, resold them to neighbors at a 10% discount to earn a margin, and unwittingly became a money laundering conduit.
